Page.Name: page.nav.context
Page.Title: Context menu
Page.Subtitle: Raven's own menus: any Menu without a parent opens as a context menu. Rwidget_set_context_menu attaches one to a widget (right click); Rmenu_open opens it anywhere. They have check items, separators, shortcuts and nested menus. For the menu of macOS itself, see Custom, macOS context menu.

Demo.Title: On tree rows
Demo.Note: Rtree_view_set_context_callback gives the item under the pointer: see Data, Tree.
